slides.body:
With a *timezone*.
The engineer reading this
is somewhere else.

slides.body:
From *both sides*.

same moment.

slides.body:
Including the honest version:

slides.title: Why that one matters
steps: It moves the case out of tier one.
It says the reader doesn't start from the beginning.
It removes the delay that belongs to *you*.

slides.title:
A case is a document
you're asking a *stranger*
to act on.
